scripts.quest:reverse: ~/.metavr/bin/metavr adb reverse tcp:8443 tcp:8443 && ~/.metavr/bin/metavr adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081
scripts.quest:open: ~/.metavr/bin/metavr shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d https://localhost:8081/ com.oculus.browser
scripts.quest:open-2d: ~/.metavr/bin/metavr shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d http://localhost:8443/viewer.html com.oculus.browser
